title: REAR SUSPENSION-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 4, rear suspension (independent rear suspension / IRS): propeller shaft (driveshaft), axle drive shafts (half shafts), differential carrier and spindle (trailing) arms (A2), rear shocks and bumper (A3), suspension attaching parts (A4), strut rods (camber rods) (A5), rear leaf spring and differential mounting bracket (A6), rear suspension geometry / alignment (A7). An overview drawing shows where each sheet's parts sit under the car. Vehicle springs and trim heights are in UPC 0.
notes: VEHICLE SPRINGS & TRIM HEIGHTS, SEE UPC 0.
